;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Santa Fe High School shooting]]
**A [[List of school shootings in the United States|school shooting]] takes place at [[Santa Fe High School (Texas)|Santa Fe High School]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]]. Eight students and two teachers are killed and thirteen others are injured. [http://abc13.com/reports-of-shots-fired-at-santa-fe-high-school-/3490869/ (KTRK-TV)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-44173954 (BBC)] 
*A gunman opens fire on the [[Trump National Doral Miami]] golf resort in [[Doral, Florida|Doral]], [[Florida]], before being shot and wounded by police. No other victims were reported. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2018/05/18/one-person-arrested-after-reports-of-shots-fired-at-trump-national-doral-golf-course-in-florida/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2018/05/18/trump-doral-golf-club-miami-gunman-opens-fire/622306002/ (''USA Today'')]
*A shooting takes place outside of a high school graduation at [[Mount Zion High School (Jonesboro, Georgia)|Mt. Zion High School]] in [[Jonesboro, Georgia]]. One person is killed and another wounded. [http://www.latimes.com/nation/nationnow/la-na-georgia-graduation-shooting-20180519-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')] [http://fox2now.com/2018/05/19/2-arrested-in-killing-outside-georgia-graduation/ (FOX2Now)]

;Business and economy
*[[Facebook–Cambridge Analytica data scandal]]
**[[Cambridge Analytica]] files for [[Chapter 7, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 7 bankruptcy]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/05/18/politics/cambridge-analytica-bankruptcy/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Cubana de Aviación Flight 972]]
**A Boeing 737 crashes shortly after taking off from [[Havana]], [[Cuba]], with 104 passengers and nine crew on board. Only three people are reported to have survived the crash. One survivor later dies from her injuries. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/18/americas/cuba-airliner-crash/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-44176899 (BBC)]
*Over 30 people are injured, seven seriously, in a bus collision at [[Lincoln Tunnel]] between [[New Jersey]] and [[New York (state)|New York]], United States. [http://www.businessinsider.com/lincoln-tunnel-bus-crash-injures-more-than-30-people-2018-5 (''Business Insider'')]

;Health and environment
*[[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola virus outbreak]]
**Two more cases of [[ebola]] reported in the city of [[Mbandaka]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. 25 people have died this year in the country from the disease, with a wider outbreak feared. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/18/more-ebola-cases-confirmed-in-congolese-city-of-mbandaka (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]]
**[[Sergei Skripal]] is discharged from hospital after two months. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44165718 (BBC)]

*[[Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh]]
**The government of [[Myanmar]] agrees to repatriate 1,101 [[Rohingya people|Rohingya]] refugees out of a list of over 8,000 submitted by their [[Bangladesh]]i counterparts. There are currently over 700,000 Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh.
